work: PDFから取り出した表を原本と照合する練習セットを作る。
hypothesis: A small reusable source-and-answer kit may help readers detect PDF table extraction mistakes. Editorial hypothesis, not measured demand.

deliverable.source: Original fictional two-page PDF with four supply rows and repeated table headers.
deliverable.answer: Expected answer CSV with page/row/item/quantity/unit fields.
deliverable.worksheet: Blank reconciliation TSV for comparing page/row/column to extracted value.
deliverable.article: Short practical article after asset validation, written by latest available model subagent and reviewed by coordinator.

remainingRows: Choose two distinct fictional supply rows during authoring; no real business or personal data.
deliberateErrorExamples: Repeated table header treated as a data row.
Quantity taken from the neighboring row.
Unit 箱 changed to 枚.
claimsBoundary: Clearly label fictional practice data and deliberate errors. Do not call these observed AI output, benchmark results or accuracy claims.

overlapReview.tableCleanup: Owns normalizing an existing table; preserve its content and observation through Nov18. Do not reuse leading-zero, blank or duplicate examples.
overlapReview.ragInventory: Owns document scope/inventory; preserve observation through Nov9. Extraction reconciliation is a different reader task.

freezeScope: No changes to existing article bodies, dates, shared UI, service procedure link or GitHub README. New article/listing/resource package only after validation.
futureConfound: Any new inbound service link and collection addition must be recorded prospectively at publication.

sources.supports: Model-specific extraction represents table rows, columns and page regions. Do not generalize to all AI tools.
Confidence estimates are not a substitute for checking output against source; review requirements depend on use.

cost: No account or paid API needed. Original local assets.
validationPlan: Render both PDF pages and verify all four rows, quantities, units and page references against answer CSV.
Check TSV can record all three deliberate errors; distinguish source, answer and practice errors.
Latest-model article draft, coordinator facts/style/overlap review, existing article package build and live checks on publication.
coordinatorReview: Accepted distinct scope and zero-cost path; assets and public copy not created this run.
